ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (26) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Kant's italics on «Различие религий» (razlichiye religiy, 'difference of religions') and «религия» are restored; his «веры» (very) in historical events are 'beliefs', and «уставная церковная вера» (ustavnaya tserkovnaya vera) is 'statutory church faith'. Bigelow's «чистой совести» (chistoy sovesti) is 'pure conscience', and Hafiz's saying stays inside the Sufi passage as printed.
